Opponents' rents are already dangerously high, so keeping cash feels less critical since I could go bankrupt regardless—unmortgaging leaves me around $84, but I could always re-mortgage Boardwalk or Park Place later for liquidity if needed. Given the small net cost after re-mortgage flexibility and the upside of collecting $70 rent plus eventually building houses, I'll go ahead and unmortgage Park Place.
